experiment_data.hypothesis: KL+compensation at 50% sparsity (s42) recovers quality similar to 30% compensation, validating that compensation heads generalize across sparsity levels.

spec.command: nohup bash -c 'source /root/.bashrc && cd /root/distill_sparse_swiglu && WANDB_MODE=offline CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 python -u src/train_compensation.py --predictor_checkpoint checkpoints/mvp_kl_norm_v2_s42/predictor_kl_normalized.pt --sparsity_target 0.5 --num_steps 1000 --batch_size 4 --seq_len 2048 --lr 1e-4 --seed 42 --dataset wikitext-103 --log_every 100 --output_dir checkpoints/kl_comp_50pct_s42 --gpu 0' > ~/runs/distill_sparse_swiglu/kl_comp_50pct_s42.log 2>&1 &
